issues.explanation: Chapter 105 says Ma Dai supports Wei Yan and then suddenly kills him, but omits the crucial handoff that Kongming secretly ordered Ma Dai to carry out the execution and that the brocade pouch coordinates the plan. This makes Ma Dai's reversal appear unmotivated.
issues.suggested_fix: Add that Kongming had secretly instructed Ma Dai to kill Wei Yan, and that Yang Yi's pouch reveals the timing and method of the plan.
